title: 1 vs 50 (Nova Only Had a Broom)
altTitles: 1 Stick Figure vs 50 With a Broom
description: Fifty grey goons. One Nova. One broom (then half a broom). #stickfigure #stickfight #1vs50 #animation #shorts
topic: INK-03 F5 stick-fight Short: Nova vs 50 grey goons in a paper courtyard, armed only with a broom

snippets.STYLE: Cinematic 3D animated film. The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features except two small glowing oval eyes, and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading. Consistent glossy 3D render in every frame, never flat 2D. Each face is only two small glowing eye-dots: no mouth, no nose, no teeth, no brows, no smile. Hands end in at most three rounded nubs. Every figure is a separate, distinct body with clear space around it; bodies never fuse or merge. Hits burst into dry puffs of ink dust and glassy sparks, never blood or splatter.
snippets.NOVA_BROOM: NOVA: a tall slender black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, magenta (#FF3DA5) glowing eye-dots and rim light, a single curved topknot line rising from the head, holding a plain wooden push-broom with pale straw bristles in her right hand as her staff.
snippets.NOVA_HALF: NOVA: a tall slender black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, magenta (#FF3DA5) glowing eye-dots and rim light, a single curved topknot line rising from the head, holding a snapped half of a wooden broom (short splintered handle, pale straw bristles) in her right hand as her staff.
snippets.GOON: GOON: a plain matte-black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, steel-grey (#9AA4B2) glowing eye-dots and a steel-grey rim light, no accessories, no markings
snippets.SET: In a circular courtyard of pale stone flagstones ringed by tall folded-paper walls and warm paper lanterns at dusk, blank unmarked paper
snippets.AVOID: Avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, mouths, noses, teeth, eyebrows, smiles, human faces, skin, hair, realistic human hands, fingers beyond three rounded nubs, clothing beyond the listed accessories, extra limbs, fused or merged bodies, more than ten goons in frame, blood, gore, splatter, red liquid, flat 2D cartoon look, flat or empty backgrounds.
snippets.SOUL: stick figure, NOT a human, no face, no mouth, only two glowing eye-dots, no skin, no clothing except listed accessory. Vertical 9:16 frame.
snippets.DRIPTINK: a single glossy ink drip falling and landing, followed by one bright crisp glass tink, clean and close
snippets.AMB: calm dusk courtyard ambience: soft wind through paper walls, paper lanterns creaking gently, seamless
snippets.FIGHT: stick-figure fight: fast broom whooshes, straw bristle swishes, bright glassy impact tinks and soft ink-dust puffs, no flesh hits
snippets.DRUMS: fast taiko drums at 140 bpm with koto-synth accents, intense fight rhythm, instrumental

qc: INK-03: CS4 at 9:16 is unverified; if S1-S5 or S7-S11 fail aspect or look, re-roll on hf-seedance-2-5 (SDi 9:16) from a keyframe (KF-N03-01 is in the script). Counter: labels step exactly with on-screen defeats (5 + 5 + 5 + 10 + 7 + 6 + 6 + 6 = 50); after first render retime every decrement to the actual burst/sweep frame, and if a clip shows a different number of defeats, re-roll it rather than editing the count. Crowd: at most 10 goons in any frame (S1/S5/S6/S12 = 10, S3 = 10); reject any shot with more, and any fused or merged bodies (step through S5/S6 pile and S7 burst). Drift: broom always in Nova's RIGHT hand, full broom S1-S3, half broom from the S3 snap through S11; S12 gag = she is back with a fresh whole broom so the loop lands on the S1 full-broom keyframe; topknot and magenta rim in every shot. Goons plain matte black with steel-grey eye-dots, no accessories, no crimson. Faces: eye-dots only; any mouth, nose, teeth, brows or smile even 1 frame = reject. Hands: max three rounded nubs. Hits = ink dust + glassy sparks, never blood/splatter. Style: glossy 3D, never flat 2D; paper walls blank. Labels: counter only, lower third, never over faces. Audio: ambience bed under every section, no silence > 1.5 s; drip-tink at 0.0 and on the shard (S11 5.0). Lore: Nib-shard sliver gold glint in S11. Seam: loop S12 end ring = S1 start ring (KF-N03-01, endFrame on Seedance). Global gate (brief §0.3): accent hue shift >6 frames / missing accessory = re-roll; 3rd or fused limb >=3 frames = re-roll; lost rim light or flat bg = re-roll. Check sourceSpec width/height/duration every clip.
